responsibility: Describes the automaton-based instruction scheduling model for the GR5 processor variant. It defines the single-issue execution resources, memory, EAM, and FIFO-style FPU slots, then assigns instruction type reservations, latencies, and bypass hazard rules such as gr5_hazard_bypass_p so the scheduler can model GR5-specific pipeline timing, memory hazards, and long-latency arithmetic/FPU behavior after RTL expansion.
